# Count Dawn

> Count Dawn is a free reverse horde survival browser game, built for GMTK Game Jam 2026: a vampire hunts waves of human hunters, collects blood, defeats their leader, and races back to his coffin before sunrise.

## About

- [Dotan Veretzky](https://dotanv.vercel.app/): software engineer, game developer, web and AI developer. Author of Count Dawn.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dotan-v/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DotanVG)
- [Personal site](https://dotanv.vercel.app/)

## Play

- [Play Count Dawn](https://count-dawn.vercel.app/): browser game, no install required.
